examples.arabic: المشكلة دي ليها تاريخ طويل من سنين كتيرة.
examples.english: This problem has a long history from many years ago.
examples.transliteration: El-moshkila di liha tarikh tawil min sinin ketira.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: حتى بعد السنين دي كلها احساسنا بقي كاننا ما بعدناش
examples.english: Even after all these years our feeling remained as if we had not parted.
examples.transliteration: hatta baad el seneen de kolaha ehsasna baea kaenena ma baadnash

examples.arabic: أنا كنت مبسوط أوي لما شوفته بعد سنين
examples.english: I was very happy when I saw him after years.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot awi lama shoftoh ba'd sneen

examples.arabic: ده كان صاحبي القديم احمد اللي مشفتهوش من سنين
examples.english: This was my old friend Ahmed whom I haven't seen for years
examples.transliteration: Da kan sa7bi el qadeem Ahmed elli ma shoftehosh men sneen

examples.arabic: كان معاه ابنه الصغير عنده خمس سنين
examples.english: He had his small son with him, five years old.
examples.transliteration: Kan ma'ah ebno elsoghayar 'ando khamas saneen.

examples.arabic: قربت عشان اسلم عليه وطلع صاحبي احمد اللي مشفتهوش من سنين
examples.english: I approached to greet him, and it turned out to be my friend Ahmed, whom I hadn't seen in years
examples.transliteration: Arrabet 'ashan asallem 'aleih we tala' saahby Ahmed elle ma shuftuhush men sneen
